plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the Bachelor of Science in Chemistry (B.S.C.), McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, from the USC Major Map Repository detail page. All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (17/18/15/18/14/15/12/12 at slot minimums); map slot-minimums sum to 121 total, official degree minimum 120 (Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 37 major, 44-50 college/program, 34-40 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes (0-minimum slots marked required_zero per the BACKLOG-18 variable-credit convention): STAT 509/515 (0-3) not required if CHEM 141/142/322/322L all completed at USC or if CHEM 621/621L completed (then take an approved elective); CSCE 106 (3) or CSCE 145 (4) transcribed at 3. Course requirements automatically meet ACS certification qualifications. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
